title: Zameer
desc: A young man claims to be a horse-breeder's long-lost son, but all is not as it seems when he falls in love with the horse-breeder's daughter.

title: S 3
desc: A police officer is assigned to solve the murder of the police commissioner. However, when he stumbles across a criminal syndicate, he decides to put an end to their tyranny.

title: Parivaar
desc: When a young girl is thrown out of her home by her evil relatives, she finds shelter with a poor street performer and his two children, a dog and a monkey.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, an upright police officer, and his brother Lakhan, a playboy, vow vengeance when they learn that their father was killed by two wicked tricksters.
